name: Hikari
source: A restless but kind boy who has a habit of tormenting [url=/c78580]Kaori[/url] and peoples he likes a lot, including [url=/c67272]Mio[/url] because he often raises her skirt to see her panties. According to Mio, he has so much charisma that he is the "head" of the children hospitalized in the establishment.
